A representative can review your billing and explain why the charges are appearing. Calling is the quickest way to get help, and the line is available 24/7 for assistance.  Speak Directly with Avast Customer Support Unexpected charges can feel alarming, especially when you don't recognize them. Instead of guessing, call the Avast Support Team at ((+1-(866).465.1368)) and explain what you're seeing. Customer Support can verify your account and tell you exactly what's causing the charges. This saves time and reduces stress.
